reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 7, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: An object's mass measures 15 g. About how many g is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object's mass measures 5 g. About how many g is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object's mass measures 53 g. About how many g is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object's mass measures 35 g. About how many g is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object's mass measures 11 g. About how many g is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object's mass measures 64 g. About how many g is that, rounded to the nearest 10?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: 'Estimate mass' requires judging an unknown mass, but seed 50 states 'An object's mass measures 64 g' outright and only asks for a nearest-ten rounding of an already-given exact value -- the estimation step never happens, in any of the 6 samples.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The competency lists grams, kilograms, and/or milligrams, yet all 6 rendered values (15, 5, 53, 35, 11, and the new cloze-format seed 50's 64) are in grams only; kilograms and milligrams never appear in this widened sample.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: 'An object's mass measures 64 g' (seed 50) names no real object a grade 3 pupil could picture; the referent-free phrasing repeats identically across all 6 samples instead of anchoring to a nameable item like a mango or a pencil.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formatter changes from mcq (42-46) to cloze (50) but the sentence frame does not: every seed is 'An object's mass measures X g...rounded to the nearest 10?', with no unit-choice, comparison, or true estimation-without-a-given-value variant anywhere in the widened sample.

competency_alignment.rationale: Difficulty only moves the rounded value from 5 g to 64 g in identical single-step-ten increments; the ramp never escalates toward kilogram-scale estimation, so the progression does not build the mass-sense this competency names.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Even the new cloze seed 50 keeps the same flaw as seeds 42-46: its distractors for the key 60 are 61, 62 and 59, none of which is a multiple of ten, so a pupil rounding 'to the nearest 10' can spot the only round-looking option (60) without doing any rounding arithmetic.
